text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about bias and fairness. If AI learns from unfair data, it can treat some groups of people badly. Privacy is another big concern, because AI often needs large amounts of personal information. Companies should also be transparent, meaning they should explain how their AI works. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and good for everyone. Governments, engineers, and ordinary people all need to work together to make sure AI helps society instead of harming it.
